entries.title: Amnesia: The Dark Descent

emulation.notes: Use the current PC release for capture, custom stories, and official update content.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with settings/mod flexibility and custom-story support.

primary.version: Current PC release with Justine and Hard Mode
primary.why: The current Windows PC release is the best route because it has the original game, the Justine expansion/update content, Hard Mode support, custom-story/mod support, and PC capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Amnesia: The Dark Descent on Steam or GOG and play the current Windows PC build. Play Justine after the main campaign if you want the official expansion content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Amnesia: Collection bundles The Dark Descent, Justine, and A Machine for Pigs on consoles, but it does not replace PC as the highest-fidelity/mod-capable route.

entries.title: Amnesia: Justine
entries.definitive_edition: Included with Amnesia: The Dark Descent current PC release

emulation.notes: Launch Justine from the current PC build of The Dark Descent.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with capture flexibility.

primary.version: Amnesia: The Dark Descent current PC release
primary.why: Justine is official Amnesia expansion content and is best played through the current Windows PC release of The Dark Descent, which provides the expansion plus PC capture and settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Install Amnesia: The Dark Descent on Windows PC and launch the Justine campaign after the main game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Justine is expansion content rather than a separate full sequel, but it is a named official campaign and appears in Amnesia: Collection.

entries.title: Amnesia: A Machine for Pigs

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it has the complete game with PC capture/settings flexibility, while later console collection versions add no sourced exclusive story or gameplay content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Amnesia: A Machine for Pigs on Steam or GOG and play the Windows PC build.

entries.remaster_caveats: Amnesia: Collection bundles the game on consoles, but no sourced remaster content advantage over PC was identified.
